question: What is the minimum number of football players required in a team for a match to start?
solution:
The correct answer is __**7 players**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **7 players** are the minimum number required for a football match to start according to the Laws of the Game.
 
• The Laws of the Game are maintained by the International Football Association Board (IFAB).
 
• Each team can have a maximum of **11 players** on the field, including the goalkeeper.
 
• If a team cannot field at least 7 players at any point during the match, the game is abandoned.
 
• The rule ensures that the game remains competitive and fair, preventing teams from playing with too few players.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **International Football Association Board (IFAB)** was founded in 1886 and is responsible for the Laws of the Game in association football.
 
• The **Laws of the Game** are the codified rules that help govern the sport of football and ensure consistency across all levels of play.
 
• In official competitions, teams are also required to have a specific number of players on the bench as substitutes, typically ranging from **3 to 7 players** depending on the competition rules.
 
• The **goalkeeper** is a crucial position and must be one of the players on the field at all times.
 
• Substitutions can be made during the match to replace tired or injured players, ensuring that a team can maintain at least the minimum number of players required.
